full_prompt_en: A square documentary-style photograph records a monumental grayscale face painted across a weathered wall between red brick piers. The mural fills nearly the entire central rectangle, cropped closely at the forehead and chin. The person's wide, alert eyes look slightly toward the right side of the frame; heavy shaded brows, a broad nose, and closed lips are modeled in black, gray, and faded cream. Dark hair and a deep black area along the right cheek frame the pale central face. The portrait has the scale of the wall itself rather than a framed picture. Layers of torn newsprint and old paper show through the painted skin, especially on the forehead and nose, though their small printed lines are too worn to read. Vertical drips, scratches, patches of exposed plaster, and reddish stains interrupt the image. The wall is enclosed by rough red brick at both sides and a dark horizontal lintel above. At lower left, leafy green shrubs obscure part of the cheek and lower edge, giving a clear sense of the mural's outdoor setting and its large size. A narrow strip of stained pavement remains at the bottom. The eyes are the sharpest painted features, while the lower face dissolves into the damaged paper and wall texture. Overcast daylight illuminates the facade evenly, with the lintel and vegetation supplying the deepest physical shadows. The photographic view preserves both the graphic black-and-white portrait and the actual coarse masonry around it. The overall composition is frontal and imposing, its quiet expression made vulnerable by the peeling, layered surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形纪实风格照片记录一张巨大灰度人脸，画在两侧红砖壁柱之间的风化墙面上。壁画几乎填满中央矩形区域，额头和下巴都被紧紧裁切。人物睁大的眼睛略望向画面右侧；浓重阴影下的眉、宽阔的鼻子与闭合嘴唇由黑色、灰色和褪色奶油色塑出。深色头发及右侧脸颊旁的大块浓黑围住较浅的面部中央。这张肖像的尺度就是整面墙，而非一幅有画框的画。撕裂的旧报纸和纸张层次透过绘制的肌肤显露，额头与鼻部尤为明显，然而细小印字已磨损到无法辨读。竖向流痕、刮痕、露出灰泥的斑块及红褐污渍打断图像。两侧粗糙红砖与上方一道深色水平门楣围住墙面。左下方，绿叶灌木遮住部分脸颊和下缘，清楚显示壁画处于户外且尺度巨大。底部还留有一条狭窄的染污铺地。双眼是最清晰的绘制部位，下半张脸则融入破损纸张和墙体肌理。阴天日光均匀照亮立面，门楣与植被形成最深的实体阴影。摄影视角同时保留图形化黑白肖像与周围真实粗粝的砌墙。整体构图正面而具有压迫感，平静神情因剥落的层叠表面显得脆弱。
style_prompt_en: The documentary photograph centers a large grayscale image fused with a materially weathered support. High-contrast black and pale cream marks define the main form, while mid-gray paper layers remain visible through the paint. Torn edges, vertical drips, rubbed areas, old print fragments, and exposed rough substrate create dense texture without an even decorative pattern. A firm rectangular enclosure and horizontal upper bar provide geometric structure; organic dark-green occlusion along a lower edge interrupts that rigidity. Most of the focal region is frontally lit by diffuse outdoor light, so tonal depth comes from painted shading and surface damage rather than dramatic cast shadow. Fine detail concentrates in a few sharp central features, with lower and peripheral areas losing definition into decay. Muted brick red and green remain secondary to the near-monochrome center. The overall effect is monumental but fragile, balancing graphic clarity against the physical erosion of the surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅纪实照片把大型灰度图像与发生物质风化的底材结合在中央。高反差黑色与浅奶油色痕迹界定主要形体，绘层下面仍透出中灰纸张层次。撕裂边缘、竖向流痕、磨擦区域、旧印刷碎片和露出的粗糙底层形成密集肌理，却不是均匀装饰纹样。坚实的矩形围合与上方水平横带提供几何结构；下缘有机的深绿遮挡打断这种规整。焦点区域大多受户外漫射光正面照亮，因此明暗深度来自绘制的阴影和表面损坏，而非戏剧化投影。细节集中在少数清晰的中央部位，下方和外围则逐渐失去轮廓、融入磨损。灰暗砖红与绿色都从属于近单色的中心。整体效果宏大却脆弱，在图形清晰度与表面真实侵蚀之间保持平衡。
theme_en: A monumental grayscale face on a weathered brick wall
theme_zh: 风化砖墙上一张巨大的灰度人脸
name: Rone
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
